mapper.select: select spf.Pf_Name as pfName, spf.Pf_Code as pfCode, spf.Pf_Formula as pfFormula, spf.Pf_Verification as pfVerification, spf.Pf_Sort as pfSort, spf.Pf_Write as pfWrite, mn.* from Pay_Field_Dtl mn left join Sys_Pay_Field spf on spf.id=mn.Pf_Id where mn.Pay_Id=#{payId} order by spf.Pf_Sort asc
